authorization: The owner delegated the pending engine decisions on 2026-09-25 (“stop asking me for permissions, just get it done”). This record decides one thing: whether the released charts follow the engine's new clock. It is not a standing permission to recompose released copy.
reason: @zodiacs/engine 0.1.1-rc.8 computes on observed ΔT (model zodiacs-deltat/1), and the calculators follow it. These pages were computed with astronomy-engine and its own Delta-T formula, which their Engine line names. Recomputed on the new clock at the same noon reference instants, the 5,010 body positions of the 501 records move by at most 19.06″ (a Moon before 1800). 18 of them would change in the second decimal of their displayed degree, and no body would change sign. That is below what the released copy states, and recomposing it would re-release 501 frozen records for no change a reader could act on.
method: For each record's computation.utcInstant, the ten bodies through src/lib/engine/server-ephemeris.ts once with astronomy-engine's DeltaT_EspenakMeeus and once with @zodiacs/engine/deltat's deltaT; the first reproduces every stored placement degree.
revisitWhen: A recomposition of released copy for any other reason, or a published statement that these pages use the calculators' clock.
